rationale: FX03 flags cost_currency values of U_USD as non-USD, but the raw schedule presents the amortized cost and fair value columns in dollars. Representative position rows and the schedule totals show dollar-denominated costs; foreign-currency references appear in instrument principal or fair-value parentheticals, not as the amortized-cost reporting currency. The check is treating a USD unit label alias as non-USD rather than finding a real non-USD cost value.
